verdict.rationale: Canva documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with its design capabilities, and it points users to setup steps for connecting a personal AI assistant. A tools reference covers generation, editing, export, asset management and comments, with rate limits and plan tiers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent (some tools are also limited to Pro and above plans).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Canva MCP server enables AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Canva's design capabilities.
If you're a user wanting to connect your personal AI assistant to Canva's AI Connector, see our [Help Center](https://www.canva.com/help/mcp-agent-setup/).
give your users access to Canva's design capabilities through natural language, directly from the AI tools they already use
official MCP server documented at https://www.canva.dev/docs/mcp/
